description: This Java class defines the EnableConnectionLogsStrategy which handles EnableConnectionLogs commands within the system. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements methods to generate responses and specify actions based on connection state.

classes.name: EnableConnectionLogsStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy to handle EnableConnectionLogs commands, providing response creation and actions to perform.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Generates a response to the EnableConnectionLogs command based on the current connection state and headers.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a list of connection actions to execute for this strategy, including broadcasting, sending response, and enabling logging.
